fvwm-menu-directory-help.stdout:
A perl script that builds directory listing for fvwm.

Usage: <ROOT>/tools/fvwm-menu-directory [OPTIONS]
Options:
	--help             show this help and exit
	--version          show the version and exit
	--name=NAME        menu name,  default is 'MenuBrowser'
	--title=NAME       menu title, default is '%*-40p'
	--item=NAME        menu item format, default is '%n'
	--icon-title=XPM   menu title icon, default is none
	--icon-dir=XPM     menu dir   icon, default is none
	--icon-file=XPM    menu file  icon, default is none
	--icon-app=XPM     menu +x    icon, default is none
	--wm-icons         define icon names to use with wm-icons
	--dir=NAME         starting dir, default is '<ROOT>/home'
	--order=NUM        NUM (-6 .. 6), default is 5
		1 - do not sort,  2 - dirs first, 3 - files first
		4 - sort by name, 5 - dirs first, 6 - files first
		Negative number represents reverse order.
	--all              show hidden files, default is no
	--links            follow linked dirs, default is no
	--xterm=CMD        xterm call, default is 'xterm -e'
	--exec-title=CMD   title exec command, default is '/bin/sh'
	--exec-file=CMD    file exec command, default is 'fixture-editor'
	--exec-app[=CMD]   +x files exec command, default is '-'
	--command-title=CMD title fvwm command, default is '-'
	--command-file=CMD file fvwm command, default is '-'
	--command-app=CMD  +x files fvwm command, default is '-'
	--reuse            no popups, reuse the same menu (no)
	--check-subdirs    check subdir for +x permission (no)
	--special-dirs[=X] include .. and ~ directories (no)
	--memory-for-speed use speed optimization (no)
	--menu-style=NAME  assign specified MenuStyle name to menus
Short options are ok if not ambiguous: -a, -icon-f.

fvwm-menu-xlock-help.stdout:
A small perl script which builds xlock menu for fvwm.

Usage: <ROOT>/tools/fvwm-menu-xlock [OPTIONS] [-- XLOCK-OPTIONS]
Options:
	--help           show this help and exit
	--version        show the version and exit
	--name=NAME      menu name,  default is 'XLockMenu'
	--title=NAME     menu title, default is 'XLock Modes'
	--item=NAME      menu item format, default is '%n\t(%d)'
	--icon-title=XPM menu title icon, default is no
	--icon-item=XPM  menu item  icon, default is no
	--wm-icons       define icon names to use with wm-icons
	--special-first  put special modes first
Short options are ok if not ambiguous: -h, -t.

Some useful xlock(1) options, 'xlock -h' for more:
	-delay usecs     delay between batches of animations
	-nolock          screensaver, don't lock the display
	-inwindow        run in window as opposite to -inroot
	-sound           turn on sound if enabled
	-nice level      decrease the process priority (0 .. 19)

directory-default.stdout:
DestroyMenu recreate "<ROOT>/files"
AddToMenu "<ROOT>/files"
+ DynamicPopDownAction DestroyMenu "<ROOT>/files"
+ MissingSubmenuFunction FuncFvwmMenuDirectory
+ "Fixture" Nop
+ "" Nop
+ "Folder" Popup "<ROOT>/files/Folder" item +100 c
+ "linked-folder" Popup "<ROOT>/files/linked-folder" item +100 c
+ "Å_folder" Popup "<ROOT>/files/Å_folder" item +100 c
+ "alpha" Exec fixture-editor "<ROOT>/files/alpha"
+ "apostrophe'file" Exec fixture-editor "<ROOT>/files/apostrophe'file"
+ "café" Exec fixture-editor "<ROOT>/files/café"
+ "cash$$&&file" Exec fixture-editor "<ROOT>/files/cash\$$&file"
+ "linked-file" Exec fixture-editor "<ROOT>/files/linked-file"
+ "program" Exec fixture-editor "<ROOT>/files/program"
+ "quote\"file" Exec fixture-editor "<ROOT>/files/quote\"file"

xlock-default.stdout:
DestroyMenu XLockMenu
AddToMenu XLockMenu "XLock Modes" Title
+ "alpha	(Shows Alpha pattern)" Exec xlock -mode alpha
+ "beta	(Shows Beta pattern)" Exec xlock -mode beta
+ "" Nop
+ "blank	(Shows Blank screen)" Exec xlock -mode blank
+ "random	(Random mode)" Exec xlock -mode random

xlock-format-special-first.stdout:
DestroyMenu FixtureMenu
AddToMenu FixtureMenu "Fixture" Title
+ "%menu/lock.xpm%blank: Blank screen" Exec xlock -nolock -inwindow -mode blank
+ "%menu/lock.xpm%random: Random mode" Exec xlock -nolock -inwindow -mode random
+ "" Nop
+ "%menu/lock.xpm%alpha: Alpha pattern" Exec xlock -nolock -inwindow -mode alpha
+ "%menu/lock.xpm%beta: Beta pattern" Exec xlock -nolock -inwindow -mode beta
